dct_description_sm: The objectives of this project are:  1) to continue measuring levels and trends of persistent organic pollutants (POPs) in Canadian arctic air and water; 2) to develop a passive water monitoring program for POPs in the Beaufort Sea and 3) to screen for new and emerging compounds of concern in the Canadian arctic.
